identityLimits: Ward scene and previously inspected ARK reference are recognized. Candidate setting mapping not inspected. This is anonymous candidate presentation, not a blind cross-game trial.

cam_hill.reason: B restores pronounced tree shade on the plaza and right-hand wall, shaded crown volume and architectural contact. A has an almost uniformly pale hero canopy and much less contact/overlap across the plaza.
cam_hill.remaining: Both have gray/pale foliage, highly repetitive broad paving, weak basin/sky depth and conspicuous raster edges. Orange tree retained as scene content; its placement or palette is not permission for removal.

cam_avenue.reason: A gives the central tree a darker crown interior, the left street convincing shade, the shop stall a shaded opening and the rear wall an orange-tree shadow. B makes the central canopy uniformly pale and the stall opening/left ground overly exposed.
cam_avenue.remaining: A still lacks natural leaf color/material richness; distant walls/geology remain flat and pale. Construction repetition and weak ground variation dominate.

cam_hero.reason: The near canopy/trunk response is very similar at this framing. Some local shadow differences are visible, but neither has a decisive overall lighting or depth advantage in the full image.
cam_hero.remaining: Both have similar gray-green leaf masses, flat individual cluster response, uniformly dark fine branches and bright pale patches; material and depth target remains unmet.

aaaComparison.reason: ARK retains more varied vegetation shape/color, canopy interior depth, irregular stone/sand transitions and cohesive foreground/middle/background layering. Preferred Ward labels improve shadows but do not close those asset/material/composition gaps.
aaaComparison.conditions: Reference camera, hardware, settings and promotional processing unknown; scene subjects differ; no performance or temporal judgement.
